title: HtmlVideo
responsibility: Renders the native video element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlVideo.attributes
inputs.description: Native video attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlVideo.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native video element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlVideo
outputs.description: The actual native video element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
